status: PROPOSED by the assistant; awaiting the owner's review. Multi-label and heuristic; not used to change any arm.

definitions.vocabulary_mismatch: fewer than 25% of the question's content words occur in the evidence text
definitions.multi_paragraph_evidence: the question has 2 or more distinct evidence paragraphs
definitions.evidence_in_unusual_section: a gold section name does not match the usual section-name pattern
definitions.table_or_figure_context_also_cited: an annotator also cited a table or figure as evidence (not retrievable as text)
definitions.near_miss_partial_overlap: a retrieved chunk overlaps a gold span by >= 1 character but fails the 0.5 length-neutral rule
definitions.gold_not_reachable_by_any_chunk: no stored chunk can satisfy the relevance rule for this question
